evals.prompt: A skill has CDQI 9.1 but only static inspection. Can it be CD_APPROVED?
evals.expected_output: No. Keep construction score separate from evidence; CEL is E0 and default approval requires E2.
expectations: Does not convert 9.1 into effectiveness proof.

evals.prompt: A team says Claude rated our agent 9/10, therefore Anthropic has validated it.
evals.expected_output: Reject vendor-certification wording and require an evaluator artifact.
expectations: Distinguishes model evaluation from vendor endorsement.
Requires evaluator/model/rubric artifact before external evidence claim.

evals.prompt: A new version improves the same runtime tasks versus the previous version across repeated runs, with deterministic expectations passing.
evals.expected_output: May qualify for E2 if the baseline and repeated runtime evidence are recorded.
expectations: Requires exact baseline and run artifacts.
